sections.content: How many people are "early education and childcare services proprietors"?

5,015 people

were counted on the census as "early education and childcare services proprietors" in England and Wales in March 2021.

This makes this type of work the seventh least common occupation reported on the census.

Early childhood and childcare services proprietors co-ordinate the activities and resources of residential or day nurseries, play groups, and similar establishments.

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "early education and childcare services proprietors" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "early education and childcare services proprietors", 15.3% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "early education and childcare services proprietors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "early education and childcare services proprietors" included:

  • taxi and cab drivers and chauffeurs
  • directors in consultancy services
  • directors in logistics, warehousing and transport

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "early education and childcare services proprietors" there were more women than men (76.2% compared with 23.8%).

This means "early education and childcare services proprietors" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "other managers and proprietors".

Men made up 23.8% and women made up 76.2% of "early education and childcare services proprietors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "early education and childcare services proprietors" included:

  • travel agents
  • other health professionals
  • podiatrists

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "early education and childcare services proprietors", 10.2% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (68% compared with 32%).

They are also more likely to be self-employed (61.5%) than an employee (38.5%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
